name: mmen-Mg2(dobpdc) exploratory stored-water candidate v1

evidence.basis: Measured McDonald 2012 75 C reference isotherm with the paper's 71 kJ/mol temperature shift; separate unary water approximation; no validated humid coadsorption or hot mixed-gas kinetics.
evidence.not_for: humid coadsorption validation, N2-purged regeneration transfer, shaped-device prediction, lifetime, CSS, annual production, hardware qualification or a measured-material winner.

shaped_material.basis: The webapp case supplies 10 kg complete dry shaped material.
shaped_material.binder_support: No candidate-specific binder or support formulation is represented.
shaped_material.particle_geometry: No measured pellet or coating is represented; shared case geometry is an explicit transfer assumption.

reference_curve.source_locator: McDonald et al. 2012 supporting information Table S5, printed S14; P@348 column is measured, other columns were generated with the paper's constant 71 kJ/mol Clausius-Clapeyron shift
reference_curve.temperature_convention: The table labels 348 K; the adapter uses 348.15 K for the stated 75 C measurement. This 0.15 K convention difference is retained as a source transcription note.

co2.basis: Measured-shape reference curve at 75 C with the paper's constant-isosteric-heat activity shift; source defines excess adsorption without an absolute-adsorption correction.

water.source_locator: Bose et al. 2023 Fig. 5c adsorption branch, visually digitized at 25 C
water.basis: Sips fit to approximate digitized unary water points. This is not a direct CO2-water coadsorption law.

nitrogen.source_locator: McDonald et al. 2012 Table 1: 0.083 mol/kg at 800 mbar and 25 C

oxygen.source_locator: McDonald et al. 2012 Table 1: 0.038 mol/kg at 200 mbar and 25 C

kinetics.evidence_status: CO2 magnitude is a transferred order-of-magnitude approximation from Darunte Avrami k at 0.4 mbar, not an LDF fit; hot desorption and water kinetics are unmeasured assumptions. Inert rates are disabled.

co2_reference_curve.locator: supporting information Table S5, P@348 column and q column

co2_temperature_shift.locator: main text Model CO2 Isotherms and supporting information Table S5

co2_25C_anchor.note: The 25 C Table S5 points are model reconstructions from the measured 75 C curve, so this is not independent withheld-temperature validation.

lead_exploratory_hot_check.class: exploratory independent digitized spot check; no acceptance gate
lead_exploratory_hot_check.locator: Fig. 5 printed page 7061; 13 isolated colored-square points
lead_exploratory_hot_check.note: The constant-71-kJ dry closure remains an approximation. Figure 3 shows loading-dependent isosteric heat outside approximately 0.3-2.4 mol/kg.

solid_cp.locator: main text DSC discussion and Fig. 8

water_curve.class: fitted to visually digitized measured curve on a different sample

water_heat.basis: water condensation enthalpy scale; no material-specific reversible-cycle heat is available

co2_kinetics.locator: supporting information Table S4, 0.4 mbar Avrami k

desorption_kinetics.basis: mirrored adsorption rate because hot desorption kinetics are not measured

shaped_transport.basis: source powder measurements transferred to the shared shaped-bed case geometry

assumptions: The 75 C measured reference curve is used with the source paper's constant 71 kJ/mol shift.
The Bose water curve is a separate unary approximation from another sample and does not supply direct humid coadsorption.
The 2012 solid heat capacity and inert Henry coefficients apply to this same McDonald sample package.
The Darunte kinetic magnitude is transferred only as a bounded first-order approximation; hot desorption is not validated.
The shared case supplies dry shaped geometry and transport; no candidate-specific pellet or coating is represented.

validity.co2_dry_equilibrium: Measured reference curve at 75 C; 25 C source-consistency reconstruction is conditional and not independent validation. The paper reports excess adsorption.
validity.co2_hot_mixed_gas: The constant-shift extrapolation and hot mixture closure are not measured validation. An exploratory 100/120 C digitized spot check retains up to 0.212 mol/kg absolute difference and no pass gate.
validity.water: Unary fit to an approximate digitized curve on another sample; no competitive/cooperative humid-mixture law.
validity.kinetics: Only an order-of-magnitude CO2 adsorption anchor is transferred; desorption and water rates are assumptions.
validity.initial_state_interpretation: The app's declared initial state is a scenario, not CSS.

uncertainty.statement: Source point uncertainty and digitization uncertainty are not propagated. Missing mixture and shaped-device uncertainty is not zero.

assumptions: The retained native water law is delegated unchanged for water equilibrium.
The native water law is not a reciprocal humid CO2 model.
No measured or explicitly calibrated CO2-water interaction is available for this candidate.
Water storage and transport are represented without rescaling the dry CO2 target.
